required_attestation_limit: The receipt records a public-publication attempt and its declared outcome for the exact artifact and destination bound by this receipt. It binds separate proposal, authority-basis, decision, execution, and outcome references where applicable. It does not independently establish factual truth, legal or contractual rights to publish, the validity of the referenced authority basis or decision, institutional trust, destination persistence, or continued public availability.
rules: artifact_digest and artifact_manifest_digest must be sha256 references
proposal_ref, decision_ref, outcome_ref, artifact_manifest_ref, and destination_ref must be reference-shaped
authority_basis_ref field must be present; null only for refused+authority_basis_missing
actor_ref must be present and reference-shaped except that it may be absent only for refused+actor_attribution_missing; actor_ref=null is never conforming
execution_ref field must be present; null exactly when publication_disposition=refused
decision_ref and outcome_ref are required for every disposition
non-null actor_ref, proposal_ref, non-null authority_basis_ref, decision_ref, non-null execution_ref, and outcome_ref must be pairwise distinct
published requires non-null authority_basis_ref, actor_ref, execution_ref, published_revision_ref, and failure_code=null
refused requires execution_ref=null, published_revision_ref=null, and failure_code in refusal_failure_codes
failed requires non-null authority_basis_ref, actor_ref, execution_ref, published_revision_ref=null, and failure_code in execution_failure_codes
destination_class must be in the closed destination_classes set
failure_code must be null or in the closed failure_codes set
required covered and excluded artifact classes must be present
attestation_limits must be an array of strings containing required_attestation_limit verbatim
forbidden raw/credential/session/legacy-collapsed fields must not appear
